Gateway to the Delta Festival is Sat.

By KRISTA MCFERRINKRISTA MCFERRIN - Charleston Sun-Sentinel
Wed,10/07/26-2:00PM, 767 Reads

CHARLESTON — The 14th annual Gateway to the Delta Festival will be held Saturday on the historic Charleston Court Square in Tallahatchie County. The event promises music, arts and crafts, a smokin’ hot car show, great food, and a huge KidsZone complete with large inflatables, putt-putt golf, tons of games and the Mayor’s ChooChoo Train and more. Join Those Who Support Local News

Local news matters to Greenwood. It keeps the people informed and connected. It asks the questions they want answered. It elevates what’s good, and it exposes what’s not.

To do that work well takes skilled reporters and editors, as many as a community can support through advertising, subscriptions and philanthropy.

The Greenwood Commonwealth expanded its newsroom in 2025 by adding Gerard Edic as a reporter covering public safety and other stories of interest to the community.

His position is partially funded by a two-year grant from Report for America, a national nonprofit. Generous supporters in the community donated the matching funds in the first year. We are now raising funds for Year 2.

Will you join this effort with a tax-deductible contribution?
